channel.title: Neutral Ground News – Bias and Credibility - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Neutral Ground News – Bias and Credibility (neutralgroundnews.com)

item.title: Krewe of Parents Parade Postponed as Kids Replace All Cleared Crap
item.description: The Krewe of Parents Mardi Gras parade is postponed indefinitely as kids refill homes with household clutter faster than it can be cleared.

item.title: Local Church Offers Fun “Ash Animal” Designs to Spur Ash Wednesday Attendance
item.description: St. Al's will administer fun “ash animal” designs on the forehead at a drive-thru, after a short prayer, in hopes of drawing more people back to the church.

item.title: Man who hasn't been to church in two months attends Ash Wednesday mass to maintain Catholic accreditation
item.description: A local man narrowly avoids a lapse in his Catholic credentials by attending Ash Wednesday services just before his membership status shifts to Suspended.

item.title: Small Cluster of Mardi Gras Throws Relieved to Avoid Ash Wednesday Sweep
item.description: A small cluster of Mardi Gras throws reportedly survived the Ash Wednesday cleanup in New Orleans and remains hidden along a parade route.

item.title: Actor Shia LaBeouf Allegedly Seen Walking in New Orleans
item.description: Witnesses report actor Shia LaBeouf was seen moving through New Orleans, appearing to move forward with his legs in a repeated motion.

item.title: Louisiana Residents Unsure How Recent Earthquake Fits into Existing Disaster Rotation
item.description: After a 4.9 magnitude earthquake struck near Shreveport, Louisiana residents are now trying to determine where earthquakes fit within the state’s already crowded disaster rotation.

item.title: NOPD Investigating Mugging of Beloved Daylight-Saving Time
item.description: The New Orleans Police Department has identified the mugging victim found unconscious early Sunday morning as the Daylight-Saving Hour.

item.title: Sewerage & Water Board Unveils 10-Year Plan for Avoiding Responsibilities Amid Water Main Breaks
item.description: Following another water main break near Carrollton and Panola, the Sewerage & Water Board announces a bold new strategy as a citywide boil water advisory remains in effect.

item.title: SWBNO Launches Internal Review After Shockingly Learning Delays Can Be Measured in Hours
item.description: Two hour TSA delays at the New Orleans airport shock Sewerage and Water Board officials, who are now studying how delays can start and stop within the same week.

item.title: Louisiana Lawmakers Consider “S*x Tax” After Income Tax Repeal Stalls
item.description: Louisiana lawmakers can’t eliminate the income tax this year, so officials are exploring a new revenue idea: a statewide s*x activity tax.
